item.title: Piglets Big Carrot and Potato Dig
item.description: Roll up your sleeves, grab your spade and get ready to DIG! Something rather exciting is growing at Piglets Adventure Farm… and it’s time to get it out of the ground! Join us for The Big Carrot & Potato Dig, where little farmers can head into our fields and get stuck into a proper, muddy, hands-on harvest. DIG IT, HARV
